$comment: AI-rendered reference photos of the style library's bases (D-426): one per base, generated from the base's name and material class with Google Stitch (Gemini image), blank packaging on white. Placed with `pnpm styles:photos public/media/styles/manifest.json --confirm --as <staff>`; shown on the style's cards and every variant's before the engine's thumbnails. A photograph of a made box replaces the render (source `getpack`); the script never replaces a photo of another source.
